messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Subject: Post-demo: Procurement & Budget Owners for Acme - next steps

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align on procurement readiness and commercial path: 

1) Procurement path: can you confirm whether Acme will process through PO (Net terms) or corporate card for an initial purchase? Any marketplace preference (AWS Marketplace, GCP, Azure)?
2) Budget owner / economic buyer: who will own the budget and sign off (name + title)?
3) Internal approvals: who is the finance sponsor and who is the legal/corporate signatory (approximate approval chain)?
4) Timeline: expected procurement/contract timeline (weeks).

I attached a short SOW draft and a one-pager pricing sheet to help procurement/finance review. I also included a simple MAP (attached) if you want us to outline responsibilities and timeline.

Next steps I propose: 
- Jordan: confirm PO vs card, budget owner, and whether procurement wants to review MSSA + SOW (we can sign MSSA + attach SSO/data controls).
- Vivek/Aditya: prepare commercial path options (card vs PO pricing, marketplace listing details, and sample MSSA redlines).
- Schedule a meeting with procurement + finance once Jordan confirms participants.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call to walk procurement through the docs.

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOW-draft.pdf (stub), pricing-sheet.pdf (stub), MAP-Acme.xlsx (stub)

Subject: Re: Post-demo: Procurement & Budget Owners for Acme - next steps

Thanks Marissa — good demo, appreciate the follow-up. A few quick answers from our side: 

- Procurement path: We typically purchase via PO with net-30 on enterprise deals (card for small purchases only).
- Marketplace: We'd prefer to buy off our procurement vendor list; if Redwood is in AWS Marketplace that helps, but it's not required.
- Budget owner / economic buyer: Lena Ortiz, Finance Director (l.ortiz@acme.com).
- Legal signatory: Mark Rivera, CFO.
- Timeline: Our procurement cycle is ~6-8 weeks for a new vendor + MSSA review.

Procurement would like to see a standard MSSA and an itemized pricing sheet. I've cc'd procurement@acme.com to loop them in. I'll introduce Lena separately to coordinate budget sign-off.

Jordan
Head of Platform
Acme Corp
